title: Sequential media and AWSTAPE fidelity
summary: WebDAV negotiates representations over canonical Storage sequential-media objects. dev5 delegates AWSTAPE to StorageHerculesAwsTapeCodec and explicitly leaves HET unsupported.
invariants: Canonical tape semantics are logical blocks plus filemarks.
AWSTAPE six-byte headers and segmentation are edge representation mechanics.
Large segmented records and filemarks must round-trip.
Compressed HET must not be guessed, flattened or mislabeled until a qualified Storage codec exists.
